H_hierarchical.evidence: The paper mentions auto/manual operation through PLC/SCADA and manual push buttons, but does not define nested modes or composite substates.

G_guards_arith.evidence: Multiple threshold/range guards are given: elevation <= 41.60, 41.60 <= elevation <= 41.80, 41.80 <= elevation <= 42.00, and elevation >= 42.00.

A_actions_nontrivial.evidence: Transitions command concrete outputs: open back-up valve plus solenoid valves 1 and 2, open only solenoid valves, send low-level alarm to CCR, and close all valves at full level.

F_fault_recovery.evidence: Faults and equipment alarms are mentioned, including float-valve blockage, alarm fault peralatan kontrol, and MCB trip simulation, but no explicit recovery path is specified.

T1_cross_section_element.evidence: Valve roles and operating ranges are described in §4.1, while the concrete transition/action bullets appear later in §4.2/Gambar 4.7 after PLC/SCADA setup.

T2_implicit_domain_term.evidence: The paper uses auto/manual control and Operation Manual push-button terminology, implying operator-mode arbitration not fully formalized in the transition list.

T3_implicit_action_from_prose.evidence: The main valve actions are co-located with their level guards in the flowchart explanation bullets.

T4_multivar_arith_guard.evidence: All guards depend on the single water-elevation variable; there is no multi-variable arithmetic or boolean guard.

T5_composite_internal_behavior.evidence: No parent/composite state with entry, during, or exit behavior is defined.

T6_global_cross_cutting_recovery.evidence: No from-any-state fault or emergency transition to a safe state is declared.

C1_speculative_dfs.evidence: No composite-state initialization or pseudo-state chain is present.

C2_expr_ir_smt.evidence: The two inclusive range guards over elevation could benefit from expression normalization and overlap/coverage checking, but they are single-variable guards.

C3_forced_and_aspect.evidence: The full-level close rule is useful, but the paper does not state it as a global forced transition across explicit substates or as a parent during action.

C4_abstract_action.evidence: Some side effects are abstract operator/HMI outputs, such as sending the low-level alarm to CCR, but most actions are concrete valve commands.

key_nl_quotes: Jika elevasi head tank <= 41.60 akan memerintahkan back up valve + solenoid valve 1 + solenoid valve 2 beroperasi hingga air mencapai elevasi 42.00 mdpl.
Switch control untuk pengoperasian auto dan manual sebagai pola pengoperasian control valve.
one_line_pitch: A practical PLC valve-control case with several inclusive level bands, multi-actuator transition outputs, SCADA/manual-mode context, and alarm side effects, but little hierarchy or formal fault recovery.
rationale: This is a meaningful stress-test sample because the controller has clear threshold guards and non-trivial valve/alarm actions grounded in the paper. It is weaker as a top candidate because hierarchy is only a flat auto/manual mode distinction, guards are single-variable elevation comparisons, and fault handling is mostly alarm-level rather than an explicit recovery FSM. Its main baseline trap comes from cross-section reconstruction and implicit auto/manual domain semantics rather than deep structural complexity.
